caption: The video captures a shirtless man lying back in an outdoor pool, his head tilted upward, ear and wet dark hair visible, a hand at the right edge. A vertical column of water already pours onto his face against a wooden fence and autumn foliage. Over time the white frothy splash at the impact point grows larger, spreading from a compact burst into a broad foam cloud. That cloud increasingly covers the upper face, while the ear and dark wet hair remain visible at the side. More droplets scatter left and upward as the water column keeps descending. The man's head, shoulder, and chest shift downward against the fence and foliage while the splash expands around him.
relations: Continuing water column feeds the impact point, so the frothy splash expands from a compact burst into a broad cloud.
As the splash grows, it blankets the upper face while the ear and wet hair remain visible at the side.
Ongoing impact throws more droplets scattering left and upward around the descending column.
The man's head, shoulder, and chest shift downward as the splash expands around him.
